column1: # How a computer's defences react to recent break-ins it has noticed.
# A break-in is noticed when the intruder leaves suspicious logs behind; the count decays
# by about a quarter of last month's each week. The highest row whose recent_hacks the
# trace: multiplies the time per hop of the trace on the player (lower is faster).
# security_bonus: added to each security system's level (capped at 5) when a tool tests it.
# new_codes_on_connect: 1 = the computer changes its passwords whenever the player connects.
